svg.text: An engineering tag: parsed, checked against its class, renamed by supersession

g.text: tl tag create 47-FV-2001 --class ControlValve --service 'Feed gas flow control' --project P123
issue nonconformant psets.valve_data class_required: Valve data is required by the record's class and has no values
issue warning psets.valve_data.manufacturer required_in_state: Manufacturer is required
error: tag number '47-XX-1': the sequence '1' must be written with 4 digits, like 0001; 'XX' is not a registered
- seq: the sequence '1' must be written with 4 digits, like 0001 (error)
- mnemonic: 'XX' is not a registered mnemonic (error)
# filling in the property set the class requires makes the tag conform
tl pset set --project P123 47-FV-2001 valve_data manufacturer=Acme size_in=4
tl tag rename 47-FV-2001 47-FV-2002 --reason 'renumbered by the design office' --project P123
47-FV-2001 ControlValve Superseded ok Feed gas flow control
47-FV-2002 ControlValve - ok Feed gas flow control
